name: Spiteful
rule: On death it bursts: Blunt ×1.2 of its Attack to every front-row hero plus its family's signature element status (Vermin Poison, Dead Curse, Tidebound Chill …). A 1-turn tell: it swells.

effects.note: on the champion's death: Attack × multiplier of damageType to the target row, then the champion's family signature status (06 §1: cellar-vermin poison, restless-dead curse, tidebound chill)

tell: It swells for one turn before it dies.
